offering_description.value: Brokers Medicare plans for eligible consumers and health coverage for individuals, families, and small employers. Customers compare plans from multiple insurers and enroll online or with help from licensed agents.

primary_products.value: Medicare Advantage plans; Medicare Supplement plans; Medicare prescription drug plans; individual and family health plans; small-group health plans

primary_services.value: Health plan comparison; licensed insurance guidance; enrollment assistance

customer_segment.value: B2C: Medicare beneficiaries and individuals and families shopping for health coverage; B2B: Small employers seeking group coverage and insurers seeking enrollments and advertising

end_markets.value: Medicare insurance; individual and family health insurance; small-group health insurance

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: Insurers pay for new enrollments and renewals; advertising: Insurers pay for sponsored placements and advertising on the marketplace

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Brokers plans from multiple insurers to consumers and small employers; software / platform: Aggregates insurer plan information for online comparison and enrollment

geography_served.value: US national: United States, with plan availability varying by location

specialization.value: related lines: Medicare, individual and family, small-group, and ancillary coverage such as dental and vision

distribution_channels.value: online: Company-operated plan comparison and enrollment websites; direct sales: In-house licensed agents who advise and enroll customers by phone; partners / resellers: Marketing and referral partners that direct shoppers to the brokerage

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State insurance producer licensing and federal Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services marketing and enrollment rules
